name: Hormigueros (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Blue field charged with a white lozenge enclosing a blue lozenge bearing a white orb with a cross, the attribute of the Virgin of Montserrat.
history: Hormigueros is a town and municipality in western Puerto Rico, home of the basilica of Our Lady of Montserrat. The flag is based on the municipal shield; the orb with the cross is a traditional attribute of the Virgin of Montserrat.

features.role: white lozenge enclosing a blue one
orb with a cross, symbol of Christ's dominion over the world
